nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the contract owner, initialized to msg.sender at deployment.
Public uint state variable recording the last completed migration index.
Access-control modifier that requires msg.sender to equal the stored owner before executing the modified function body.
Public function guarded by the restricted modifier that updates last_completed_migration with the supplied value.
msg.sender read during state variable initialization of owner.
msg.sender read inside the restricted modifier require comparison against owner.
uint parameter completed passed by the caller into setCompleted.
State write last_completed_migration = completed performed inside the privileged function body.

edges.reason: Untrusted msg.sender flows into the owner state variable, establishing the privileged account at deployment.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared against the stored owner in the restricted modifier require check.
The owner state variable is read by the restricted modifier when validating the caller.
A failed msg.sender == owner check reverts execution before the privileged state write is reached.
setCompleted applies the restricted modifier, gating the whole function body on owner verification.
The restricted modifier must pass before the state write in the function body executes.
The body of setCompleted executes the state write operation.
The completed parameter is written into contract storage by the assignment operation.
The write operation updates the last_completed_migration state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The local parameter completed has no independent behavior; it only supplies the value for the state write, so it should be merged into the unsafe operation node representing last_completed_migration = completed.
